lead_raw_text:
The structure of Mg₂Ti₂O₆F₄ (reduced formula MgTi(OF₂)₂) crystallizes in the monoclinic space group C2/c (No. 15), with 16 atoms per unit cell distributed over four independent Wyckoff orbits. Geometry-derived coordination analysis shows Mg centers with six F neighbors, Ti centers with five F and one O neighbor, and F and O centers each with three geometric neighbors. The periodic neighbor graph forms a single three-dimensional component. Validated polyhedron contacts include corner-sharing between Mg and O polyhedra, and corner- and edge-sharing between F and Ti polyhedra.
